amount.description:
Amount in the network's base unit. Optional only when `to` already
carries one.

chain_id.description:
Pin the EVM chain. A wallet on a different chain refuses with
`forbidden` (`wrong_chain`) at plan time instead of broadcasting.

local_memo.description: Local-only bookkeeping annotation; never sent to the network.

mints.description: Restrict Cashu wallet selection to these mints, tried in order.

network.description: Network to send on, when the target is ambiguous.

to.description: Address, BOLT11 invoice, BOLT12 offer, or payment URI.

wallet.description:
Source wallet; omit to let afpay select one. The plan names the wallet
it actually picked.
